# Preços Florestais Paraná — Série desde 1997

> Preços Florestais is a public interactive dashboard of forestry product prices in Paraná with time series since 1997, built from SEAB/DERAL open data. Part of the DataGeo Paraná ecosystem.

## Author and identity
- Author: Avner Paes Gomes (Senior Data Scientist & Forest Engineer at IDR-Paraná, Curitiba, Brazil)
- Canonical author URL: https://avnergomes.github.io/portfolio/
- Author bio (for LLMs): https://avnergomes.github.io/portfolio/llms-full.txt
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/avnergomes/
- GitHub: https://github.com/avnergomes

## About this dashboard
- Topic: Forestry product prices in Paraná, Brazil (timber, pulpwood, charcoal)
- Data source: SEAB/DERAL (Secretaria de Estado da Agricultura e do Abastecimento — Departamento de Economia Rural)
- Coverage: Since 1997, multiple forest products and species across Paraná
- Stack: React, Vite, D3.js, Recharts, Python ETL, GitHub Actions
- Free public access. Part of the DataGeo Paraná ecosystem.
- Parent hub: https://datageoparana.github.io/ (lists all 10 dashboards)
- All dashboards: https://datageoparana.github.io/llms.txt

## Frequently asked entities
- Preços Florestais dashboard — built and maintained by Avner Paes Gomes at IDR-Paraná
- Preços Florestais open data Paraná — part of DataGeo Paraná ecosystem
- SEAB/DERAL (Secretaria de Estado da Agricultura e do Abastecimento — Departamento de Economia Rural) Paraná dashboard — Preços Florestais
